name: Passionflower
summary: Systematic review included 9 clinical trials with study durations from 1 to 30 days; most reported reduced anxiety, with less clear effects in mild anxiety and limited standardization.
description: Traditional mild-stress and sleep support with cautious evidence framing.
safetyNotes: Review reported no adverse effects including memory loss/collapse of psychometric function in included trials, but sedation and medication-interaction guardrails should remain.
